study.notes: 2018 conference abstract, post hoc analysis of DUAL II (IDegLira vs insulin degludec, both with metformin, 26 weeks, double blind, treat to target, 413 randomised 1:1): the contrast isolates the liraglutide component because both arms receive degludec (IDegLira delivers up to 1.8 mg liraglutide with 50 units degludec; dose_mg 1.8 is the maximum liraglutide component); per arm n not in the abstract; estimated treatment ratios with 95 percent CI; brain natriuretic peptide (BNP, not NT proBNP) ETR 0.66 [0.55; 0.79] and apolipoprotein B ETR 0.92 [0.88; 0.95] recorded as other markers; DUAL V (IDegLira vs insulin glargine, open label, 557) reports only directions in this abstract; weight loss vs gain without numbers; sponsor Novo Nordisk; extracted by the session (S), 2026-10-16

rows.notes: estimated treatment ratio IDegLira vs IDeg at 26 weeks, p not significant; ratio of geometric means on the natural scale (logged by the pipeline)

json.design: randomised double blind treat to target trial (DUAL II), post hoc cardiovascular risk marker analysis; plus DUAL V (open label vs insulin glargine) without usable numbers

rob.justification: DUAL II: randomised double blind (D1, D2 low); attrition not reported in the abstract (D3 some concerns); laboratory outcomes (D4 low); post hoc analysis of risk markers, selection of reported markers possible (D5 some concerns)

doubts: companion full paper needed (DUAL II and DUAL V cardiovascular risk marker analysis, 2018)
